  • This is a companion entry: it contains no questions. Open the official paper with the button above (it opens in a new tab), work through it on paper as normal, and record each answer on the A–H grid here.
  • The timer, flags, Review Screen and auto-submit behave exactly as in the real test. Scores feed your history and the shared leaderboard like any other paper.
  • After submitting, the review shows the correct letters from the official mark scheme; for worked solutions, use the official worked answers alongside.
  • Select the one correct option for each question. There is no penalty for a wrong answer, so attempt every question.
  • Tick Flag for review to mark a question to return to. Open the Review Screen at any time to see the status of every question and jump between them.
  • The timer runs continuously. When it reaches zero the paper is submitted automatically.
  • Keyboard: letter keys A–J or number keys 1–9/0 to answer · ← → to move · F to flag · R for the Review Screen.

Profile settings

Your account and practice history sync across devices. Use the same email and password wherever you sign in.

Required when changing your password or deleting your account.

An internet connection is needed for leaderboard updates. Your scores and attempts stay attached to the same profile.

Leaderboard privacy

Turning submissions off keeps future scores local. Existing public entries remain; use the name-update option above to change their displayed name.

Review and appearance
Practice defaults

Defaults apply to new paper selections. Saved sessions retain their own timing.

Backup and import

Export this profile’s attempts, bookmarks, journal, plans and saved sessions. Importing adds history to this account and updates preferences. Your email, name and password stay the same. The backup contains personal practice data, but no password.

Profile actions

Deleting permanently removes your cloud account, its practice history and leaderboard entries linked to this account.
